title: Project Accounting Rate Note: Change-Order Administration Fee on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Change-order administration fee on a line-set change order

The change-order administration fee on a line-set change order of a Replacement System Installations project is set by the change-order charges already posted on the project:

| Change-order charges already posted on the project | Change-order administration fee |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $95.00 |
| Exactly one | $45.00 |
| None | No fee |

## What is counted

The count is of change-order charges on the project's ledger at the time the line-set change order is charged. A change-order approval that has not been charged is not a change-order charge; a charge for a permit, an accessory or a labor-warranty upgrade is not a change-order charge.

## Cases (hypothetical projects)

- A line set billed as the first change-order charge on its project: no administration fee.
- A line set billed when change order number 1 is already charged: $45.00.
- A line set billed when change orders number 1 and number 2 are already charged: $95.00.
- A line set billed when three change-order charges are already on the project: $95.00, the same as for two.
